# Knowledge map: Mod Loader and firmware mods

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/mods.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Mod Loader v2 in QEMU and on cameras, command items, nested SMNU submenus, standalone SD auto-boot, the ILCE-6100 Picture Profile unlock and Mod Loader port, mod qualification, candidate 36-exposure film-roll tracking, and the external ZV-E10 adapted menu.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-24.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 16 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Entities

### <a id="mod-loader-v2"></a>Mod Loader v2

`mod.loader-v2` | module

RAM-only loader with a Mods tab, command items and hot reload, run in QEMU and on physical bodies.

Aliases: `mlv2`, `Mods tab`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 identifies its target in QEMU, accepts offline reload requests and runs real mods with hot reload in the QEMU Sony menu. ([E0575](../evidence/0575-qemu-mod-loader-v2-compatibility-boundary.md), [E0576](../evidence/0576-mod-loader-v2-reload-request.md), [E0577](../evidence/0577-qemu-real-mods-relocation-and-hot-reload.md))
- **C02** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 command items add a 'USB Streaming' style entry to the Mods tab. ([E0592](../evidence/0592-mod-loader-command-items-usb-streaming-entry.md))
- **C03** `PHYSICAL` Mod Loader v2 with RCRAW_Enable_Test.mod ran RAM-only on a physical ILCE-6400 (hooks installed, auto-on logged). ([E0633](../evidence/0633-a6400-hardware-rcraw-enable-test-live-run.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 was ported to the ILCE-6100 to a first milestone. ([E9103](../evidence/9103-a6100-mod-loader-port.md))
- **C06** `OFFLINE` Mods and firmware were qualified offline on 2026-11-19 without camera, SD or USB access. ([2026-11-19-firmware-qualification](../evidence/mods/2026-11-19-firmware-qualification.md))
- **C11** `PHYSICAL` PhotonBin 6MP was ported to ILCE-6100 1.00 and verified on physical hardware (6 MP 16-bit .ARW, Force HCG, and SMNU v4 core.bin). ([E9104](../evidence/9104-a6100-photonbin-6mp-port.md))
- **C08** `OFFLINE` Mod Loader v2 CTX_VERSION=3 supports FNV-verified SMNU nested submenus and hooks ImageBuilder::MakeRawInfoArea (libObj.so+0x00D7861C) in PhotonBin6MP.mod, verified in Unicorn and captured ILCE-6400A 1.01 QEMU. ([E0680](../evidence/0680-photonbin-6mp-and-mlv2-nested-submenus.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` Standalone SD auto-boot (MLV2.TAR) reads FAT32 and exFAT directly from /dev/mmca1 (block 250:11) in 4 KiB chunks without mounting the card, verified in offline suites and captured ILCE-6400A 1.01 QEMU. ([E0681](../evidence/0681-ilce-6400a-standalone-sd-boot-and-exfat-reader.md))
- **C10** `OFFLINE` Current camera helpers cannot package or stream 36 ARW exposures unmodified: card_read.c scans only root_cluster, caps archives at 4 MiB / 2,048 clusters and stages to /tmp_bt/mlv2/card.tar, while camera-daemon/src/wifi_stream.c is an MJPEG streamer that drops frames whenever SIOCOUTQ > 16,384 bytes. ([E0681](../evidence/0681-ilce-6400a-standalone-sd-boot-and-exfat-reader.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

### <a id="mod-a6100-picture-profile"></a>ILCE-6100 Picture Profile unlock

`mod.a6100-picture-profile` | module

Opt-in redirect of the Picture Profile gate on an ILCE-6100 (a6100).

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` The ILCE-6100 Picture Profile gate was located, an opt-in unlock designed and the redirect applied to a physical ILCE-6100. ([E9101](../evidence/9101-a6100-picture-profile-gate.md), [E9102](../evidence/9102-a6100-picture-profile-camera-apply.md))

### <a id="mod-film-roll-36"></a>36-exposure Film Roll mode (candidate)

`mod.film-roll-36` | module

Candidate SMOD v2 SMNU film-stock selector, 36-shot ARW roll tracker hooking ImageBuilder::MakeRawInfoArea, and zero-scratch USTAR/ZIP-STORE roll streamer.

Aliases: `FilmRoll.mod`, `36-exposure roll`

Current knowledge:

- **C10** `OFFLINE` Current camera helpers cannot package or stream 36 ARW exposures unmodified: card_read.c scans only root_cluster, caps archives at 4 MiB / 2,048 clusters and stages to /tmp_bt/mlv2/card.tar, while camera-daemon/src/wifi_stream.c is an MJPEG streamer that drops frames whenever SIOCOUTQ > 16,384 bytes. ([E0681](../evidence/0681-ilce-6400a-standalone-sd-boot-and-exfat-reader.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

Related: [Mod Loader v2](#mod-loader-v2)

### <a id="mod-wifisync"></a>WiFiSync

`mod.wifisync` | module

RAM-only SMOD v2 mod that serves new .JPG/.ARW files over a 5 GHz AP with a read-only Sony Fsys backend; camera half verified offline, physical AP gate open.

Aliases: `WiFiSync.mod`, `5 GHz transfer`, `wifisync`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` The WiFiSync camera-side core (queue, Smart Single-Best, HTTP/1.1 + Range, CRC-32, power machine) passes 72 host assertions and the same 72 assertions on Cortex-A5 Thumb under Unicorn. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-wifisync-camera-side-mod.md))
- **C13** `OFFLINE` The WiFiSync SMOD v2 mod builds as a 29,672-byte RLC1 mod with one 12-byte ConPutWriteStill hook whose original bytes equal the pinned ILCE-6400 libmpr.so, and a 311,296-byte bss. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-wifisync-camera-side-mod.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` Sony's read-only Fsys contract was re-verified by disassembly: Fsys_Open read is flag bit 0, Fsys_Stat returns a 64-bit size at offset 0, and the mod identity-checks size, first-4-KiB FNV and function prologues before any read. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-wifisync-camera-side-mod.md))
- **C15** `OPEN` The 5 GHz SoftAP (bcmdhd + wpa_supplicant AP mode + dhcpd) and the on-camera Fsys reads have not been run on a physical camera; the Phase 1/2 gates remain open. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-wifisync-camera-side-mod.md))
